protocol.name: gtk

description.summary: version 1 of the shell extension GTK clients bind

protocol.description: The requests, events and enums of version 1 only, in the order GTK clients send and receive them, so that they talk to this compositor unchanged. Later versions are not offered.

interface.name: gtk_shell1

description.summary: desktop integration for a client's surfaces

interface.description: Says what the desktop shows on the client's behalf, and gives each toplevel surface a gtk_surface1.

enum.name: capability

description.summary: what the desktop shows for the client

enum.description: A capability is sent as the bit 1 << (value - 1).

request.name: get_gtk_surface
request.description: Version 1 gtk_surface1 objects have no destructor; they go with the client.

description.summary: the startup notification the client finished
ring the bell for a surface, or for none
desktop integration for one toplevel surface

request.name: set_dbus_properties

description.summary: where the surface's menus and actions are

request.description: The unique bus name of the client's session bus connection, the object paths of its exported menus (org.gtk.Menus) and of the action groups they activate (org.gtk.Actions): "app." actions live at the application object path, "win." actions at the window object path.

description.summary: the surface is a modal dialog
the surface is no longer modal
